notes: the bracketed «[بْنُ]» in «مُحَمَّدُ [بْنُ‌] عَلِيِّ» is an editor's mark, left out
«الإمام» is a title and is left out of the surface; Imam Jafar inside the chain after «عن» stays a narrator (owner ruling 2)
Ali relays the Prophet's words of the will, so he is the last link; «عليه السلام» and «ص» are blessings
